name: ts-playwright-codex
description: Project-local Codex plugin for ts-playwright with Playwright MCP and repo-specific Playwright skills, including site discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Project-local Playwright MCP and Codex Playwright workflow entry points
interface.longDescription: Use the ts-playwright Codex plugin to run a repo-local Playwright MCP session, route Codex to the installed Playwright skills in ~/.codex/skills, and work on browser automation, site discovery, or regression tasks directly inside this repository.
defaultPrompt: Use the project Playwright MCP server to inspect the local ts-playwright UI
Use ts-playwright-e2e to design or update Playwright coverage in this repo
Use ts-playwright-browser-debug to debug a local browser flow in this repo
Use ts-playwright-site-discovery to map a site from a starting URL and produce a test-discovery document
